**Enum** in the `Latiprimere.Cups` namespace, from the [Latiprimere.Cups](/docs/reference/#latiprimerecups) package.

```csharp
public enum CupsEncryption
```

Enumerates when requests to a CUPS server travel over an encrypted (TLS) connection.

Only TCP connections are encrypted. Requests through the local scheduler's Unix domain socket never leave the machine, and CUPS doesn't ask for encryption on it.

## Values

- **`Automatic`** (`0`): Encrypted when [CupsOptions.Credentials](/docs/reference/latiprimere-cups/cupsoptions/#credentials) are set, so the password never travels in clear text; otherwise not. A standard CUPS server accepts a password from another machine only over an encrypted connection.
- **`Always`** (`1`): Always encrypted, which also keeps documents private on the network.
- **`Never`** (`2`): Never encrypted. Credentials, if set, travel in clear text, so use it only with a server that accepts them that way and only on a network you trust.
